name: automatic_payout_effective_at
meaning: The date Stripe expects the payout to arrive; also when it leaves your Stripe balance.

name: automatic_payout_id
meaning: The automatic payout this row belongs to. Rows with the same id add up to that payout.

name: available_on
meaning: When the row's net became available in your Stripe balance.

name: created
meaning: When the balance transaction was created.

name: currency
meaning: The currency of gross, fee and net.

name: description
meaning: Free text, often the order or the fee's name.

name: fee
meaning: Fees for this row, in dollars (major units). Any withheld_tax is already inside it.

name: gross
meaning: The row's gross amount: a charge's full price, a refund as a negative.

name: net
meaning: Gross less fee: what the row added to or took from the payout.

name: reporting_category
meaning: What the row is: charge, refund, dispute, fee and so on. The split places rows by it.

name: topup
booked_as: Money from or back to your bank

name: topup_reversal
booked_as: Money from or back to your bank

name: payout_reversal
booked_as: Money from or back to your bank
